name: SL-rear-lean-never-its-own
old: export const rearLean = (read) => (read && read[0] / read[1] >= REAR_LEAN[0] / REAR_LEAN[1] ? read : REAR_LEAN);
new: export const rearLean = (read) => (read && read[0] / read[1] <= REAR_LEAN[0] / REAR_LEAN[1] ? read : REAR_LEAN);

name: SL-every-run-the-front-arm
old: const front = runs.filter((r) => r[1] < w - 1 - REAR_REACH);
new: const front = runs.filter((r) => r[1] < w - 1 + REAR_REACH);

name: SL-lean-the-wrong-way-out
old: return den > 0 ? -num / den : null;   // per line IN from the edge, negated: per texel OUT
new: return den > 0 ? num / den : null;   // per line IN from the edge, negated: per texel OUT

name: SL-owner-pixels-not-restored
old: for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) out.set(data.subarray(y * w * 4, (y + 1) * w * 4), (y * W + L) * 4);   // the owner's pixels, whole

name: SL-front-arm-not-carried
old: for (let x = run[0]; x <= run[1]; x++) if (opaque(data, ((h - 1) * w + x) * 4)) put(L + x + dx, h - 1 + t, ((h - 1) * w + x) * 4);
new: for (let x = run[0]; x <= run[1]; x++) if (opaque(data, ((h - 1) * w + x) * 4)) put(L + x + dx, h - 1, ((h - 1) * w + x) * 4);

name: SL-tip-off-the-diagonal
old: if (x + y < score) { score = x + y; best = [x, y]; }
new: if (x - y < score) { score = x - y; best = [x, y]; }

name: SL-anchor-the-full-frame
old: const anchor = boxes[SPEAR_POSE.rest];
new: const anchor = boxes[SPEAR_POSE.full];

name: SL-cell-on-the-pistol-layout
old: const cells = Array.from({ length: SPEAR_STRIP.frames }, (_, i) => cutCell(strip, i, cut, SPEAR_STRIP));
new: const cells = Array.from({ length: SPEAR_STRIP.frames }, (_, i) => cutCell(strip, i, cut));

name: SL-rest-place-by-height
old: export const SPEAR_REST_AT = Object.freeze([320 - SPEAR_STRIP.cellW, 200 - SPEAR_STRIP.cellH]);
new: export const SPEAR_REST_AT = Object.freeze([320 - SPEAR_STRIP.cellH, 200 - SPEAR_STRIP.cellH]);

name: SL-thrust-not-turned-onto-the-aim
old: F('full', 8, [0, 14], { scale: 0.97, smear: true }),   // on the aim, fully out: the hit
new: F('full', 0, [0, 14], { scale: 0.97, smear: true }),   // on the aim, fully out: the hit

name: SL-down-sweeps-left
old: StrikeUp: 'thrust', StrikeDown: 'thrust',
new: StrikeUp: 'thrust', StrikeDown: 'left',

name: SL-surface-off-the-stage
old: return [p[0] - stage.x, p[1] - stage.y];
new: return [p[0] + stage.x, p[1] - stage.y];

name: SL-smear-the-hands
old: return (X, Y, qx, qy) => ((X + Y) & 1) === 0 && (qx - ox - tx) + (qy - oy - ty) < HEAD_REACH;
new: return (X, Y, qx, qy) => ((X + Y) & 1) === 0 && (qx - ox - tx) + (qy - oy - ty) > HEAD_REACH;

name: SL-smear-solid
old: return (X, Y, qx, qy) => ((X + Y) & 1) === 0 && (qx - ox - tx) + (qy - oy - ty) < HEAD_REACH;
new: return (X, Y, qx, qy) => (qx - ox - tx) + (qy - oy - ty) < HEAD_REACH;

name: SL-smear-over-the-frame
old: drawTurned(smeared, up, stagePose(frame, pivot, bled, stage));

name: SL-turn-sampled-backwards
old: const qx = (ux * c - uy * s) / scale + pivot[0] - origin[0], qy = (ux * s + uy * c) / scale + pivot[1] - origin[1];
new: const qx = (ux * c + uy * s) / scale + pivot[0] - origin[0], qy = (-ux * s + uy * c) / scale + pivot[1] - origin[1];

name: SL-turn-keeps-soft-texels
old: if (src[si + 3] < 128 || (keep && !keep(X, Y, qx, qy))) continue;
new: if (src[si + 3] < 1 || (keep && !keep(X, Y, qx, qy))) continue;

name: SL-frame-time-not-shared
old: return classic * MELEE_NUM_FRAMES.StrikeDown / SPEAR_NUM_FRAMES[state];
new: return classic;

name: SL-one-handed-heft
old: heft: swingHeft(SPEAR_ITEM.weightKg, strength), handling: swingHandling(SPEAR_HANDLING_OF, SPEAR_ITEM.twoHanded),
new: heft: swingHeft(SPEAR_ITEM.weightKg, strength), handling: swingHandling(SPEAR_HANDLING_OF, false),

name: SL-hit-on-the-classic-frame
old: m.hitFrame = SPEAR_STRIKES[SPEAR_STRIKE_OF[state]].hit;

name: SL-classic-frame-counts
old: m.frames = SPEAR_NUM_FRAMES;

name: SL-drag-upside-down
old: const strike = DIRECTION_TO_STRIKE[gestureDirection(Math.atan2(-g.y, g.x) * 180 / Math.PI)];
new: const strike = DIRECTION_TO_STRIKE[gestureDirection(Math.atan2(g.y, g.x) * 180 / Math.PI)];

name: SL-drag-on-the-sum
old: if (g.travel / longestDim < threshold) return null;
new: if (Math.hypot(g.x, g.y) / longestDim < threshold) return null;

name: SL-anchor-off-the-canvas-box
old: x: stage.x + SPEAR_REST_AT[0] + set.anchor.x, y: stage.y + SPEAR_REST_AT[1] + set.anchor.y, w: set.anchor.w, h: set.anchor.h,
new: x: stage.x + SPEAR_REST_AT[0], y: stage.y + SPEAR_REST_AT[1] + set.anchor.y, w: set.anchor.w, h: set.anchor.h,

name: SL-scrub-unsmeared
old: return { ...f, img: smear && f.smeared ? f.smeared : f.img };
new: return { ...f, img: f.img };
